centers.name: Throat
centers.note: Consistent access to expression and manifestation — but only reliably powerful when connected through the G Center (identity) rather than forced.

centers.name: G Center
centers.note: Stable sense of identity and direction. Love and direction come from a fixed, known place — not from searching outward for it.

centers.name: Head
centers.note: Consistent mental pressure/inspiration. Ideas arrive reliably — the risk is trying to answer every question that shows up instead of letting some pass.

centers.name: Ajna
centers.note: Fixed way of processing and conceptualizing. Opinions are consistent and can be trusted as genuinely yours, not borrowed from the room.

centers.name: Heart/Will
centers.note: Not here to constantly prove worth or willpower through effort. Worth is not something to be earned through output — that's a conditioning pattern to unlearn.

centers.name: Sacral
centers.note: Not a generator — no sustainable, consistent work-energy. Energy is not infinite; overworking here leads directly to burnout, not productivity.

centers.name: Spleen
centers.note: Instinctive fear/safety signals are inconsistent — decisions shouldn't be rushed on gut-fear alone; give it time to actually land.

centers.name: Solar Plexus
centers.note: Emotional weather is often absorbed from other people, not internally generated. If a feeling arrived suddenly around someone else, it might not be yours.

profileLines.line4: Opportunist/Network — builds and succeeds through trusted relationships, not cold outreach. Who knows you matters as much as what you know.
profileLines.line6: Role Model — lives in three phases: trial-and-error (roughly age 1-30), retreat/observation (30-50), role model (50+). Currently in the retreat-into-becoming phase — this is a feature, not a delay.

voiceClarityNote: Clarity comes through speaking out loud, not through silent deliberation. Talk it out before organizing it — dictation before structure.
notSelfTheme: Bitterness — shows up specifically when forcing recognition, proving worth, or working without being invited/acknowledged first.
strategyNote: Wait for recognition and invitation before initiating major moves. This isn't passivity — it's energy protection, since there's no defined Sacral to sustain constant self-initiation.
